title: Closed matrix locus on the bounded lowest-rank open
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $E$ a perfect complex in its derived category [def-pc-perfect-complex, def-pc-derived-category] with Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$ (its derived tensor with every module has zero cohomology outside this interval [def-pc-derived-tensor-cohomology-vanishes]), and $r\in\mathbf N$. Let $U\subset S$ be an open subscheme with inclusion $u$ [def-weil-open-immersion] such that $\beta_a(x)\le r$ for all $x\in U$ [def-sc-derived-fiber-betti]. There exists a closed immersion $i:Z\to U$ [def-weil-closed-immersion], locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], such that for every $h:T\to U$, $h$ factors through $i$ if and only if $H^a(L(u\circ h)^*E)$ [def-pc-derived-pullback] is finite locally free of rank $r$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. No further base changes are assumed in this criterion.

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma locally-closed-where-H0-locally-free, Tag 0BDL, proof after restriction to the rank-bound open: matrix equations, converse, finite presentation, and gluing

proof.text: Define P(T,h) to mean rank-r finite local freeness of the degree-a homology of derivedPullback(h followed by U inclusion) E. Compose the derived-pullback-composition isomorphism with exact-open-pullback homology restriction to identify this homology after any source-open restriction with ordinary restriction of the original homology sheaf. Modules.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_restrict proves restriction stability. Modules.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_of_iSup_eq_top proves source locality from the chosen neighbourhood at each source point. These comparisons use no extra perfection or Tor-amplitude hypotheses.

Apply exists_perfectLowestMatrixCharts to the given perfect complex, Tor bounds and rank-bound open. Its closed finite-presentation charts represent precisely P, with associativity of composition identifying the expressions.

Apply the proved exists_closedLocus_of_local_charts to the restriction-stable, source-local predicate P and the local charts. Unpack its global closed finite-presentation representative and factorization criterion.

proof_origin.note: The matrix-chart step is split off; the source-locality and generic gluing proofs are complete in Lean. Upper semicontinuity is unnecessary in this restriction because the prescribed residue model is used at every point, including points of smaller rank.

theorem exists_perfectLowestMatrixClosedLocus
    [∀ T : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace))]
    (S : Scheme.{u})
    [∀ U : S.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory S) (hE : IsPerfect S E) (a b : ℤ)
    (hamp : ∀ F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace),
      ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i → schemeDerivedTensorCohomologyVanishes S E F i)
    (r : ℕ)
    (U : S.Opens) (hU : ∀ x : S, x ∈ U → derivedFiberBetti S E a x ≤ r) :
    ∃ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (i : Z ⟶ U.toScheme),
      IsClosedImmersion i ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation i ∧
      (∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (h : T ⟶ U.toScheme),
        (∃ g : T ⟶ Z, g ≫ i = h) ↔
          SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u}
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)) a).obj
                ((derivedPullback (h ≫ U.ι)).obj E)) r)
